function.name: TEXT_COLOR
function.abstract: It selects the colour which it will be used to paint the texts made with functions like .

description.p: This function allows to choose the colour of text with which the characters of the fonts will be drawn to two colours. The types of letter (fonts) of 256 colours or 16 bits already include colour information and they will not be affected by this function. The types of letter to two colours can be recovered by the functions or .

The texts drawn with and derived remember the color selected at the moment that was called, although draw their text each frame. Therefore, it is valid to call to TEXT_COLOR before drawing each one and being able simultaneously to show in screen texts of several colors.

In case of graphs of 256 colours (8 bits), the value of colour must be a number of 0 to 255. In oppositive case (16 bits), the value is a codification of the components of the colour that changes based on the video card and graph mode. It is normal to use the function to obtain the codification of a concrete colour, or use a colour obtained by a function like .
